notes.title: Achievements, chapter replay, and fun new features
notes.content:
Hey folks,
Did you miss me? A big new update for A Story Beside is available now! Although I'm still working on finishing up the last two chapters for full release, this patch means we're closer to that reality than ever. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33696968/0a552f0f962139080ea7e24b75ebbfd16cdc32dc.png[/img]

In addition to fixing some long-standing bugs (collision should [i]finally[/i] be functioning properly for all players) and adding various spots of polish here and there, this update introduces a few brand new features outlined below.

[list][*][b]ACHIEVEMENTS[/b]
There will be 16 Steam achievements to unlock in the final game, including 8 that are available in the current chapters. It should be possible, if a little tricky, to nab them all on a single playthrough.

[*][b]PLAYER STATS[/b]
Remember the screens at the end of each chapter highlighting your choices? You'll now be able to see the percentage of players around the world who made those same decisions. As if there wasn't pressure enough already...

[*][b]CHAPTER REPLAY[/b]
This much-requested feature allows you to replay any previous chapter at any time.

[*][b]VOLUME CONTROLS[/b]
You can now independently adjust the volume of the music, ambience, and sound effects from the pause menu. This is a useful tool for streamers or anyone who likes to hone in on particular elements of the game's sound design.
[/list]
Please continue to report bugs as you find them and look for more updates very soon! It's been a rocky year for so many of us... I truly appreciate you sticking with me until the end.

 [url=https://twitter.com/wayward_prophet][img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11472989/ddfee936ce044d2b084bd57d8369b1a650c839c5.png[/img][/url] [url=https://youtube.com/c/waywardprophet][img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11472989/1e1136b0f826a0ba78cd7c78fbc4d72f238ac849.png[/img][/url] [img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11472989/132ef7e66b33d581306545db538a3ae2527b3ed6.png[/img]
All my best,
David Grund
[url=waywardprophet.com]waywardprophet.com[/url]

notes.title: Patch notes plus a new release schedule
notes.content:
Hello all!
I've been hard at work on A Story Beside since release, both on the development of new chapters and assorted bug-fixes that have inevitably popped up during this Early Access period. I truly appreciate everyone who has been so patient and so diligent in reporting any and all issues you've come across.

A new update is now available that contains several new features and should solve many of the bugs in the first few chapters. Please take a look at the patch notes below and be sure to post in the discussion forum if problems continue.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33696968/9423e9cdeb344e95bd77ec1454e67821b104d410.png[/img]

[h1]Updates:[/h1][list][*] Brand new menu system (should fix all menu-related bugs)
[*] Fixed bug that would trap players in certain maps after saving
[*] Fixed bug that would report incorrect player choices
[*] Fixed data bug when replaying earlier chapters
[*] Fixed item inventory
[*] Increased number of save slots (from 4 to 10)
[*] Save points added at the end of each chapter
[*] New (optional) scene with Kelsi
[*] New dialogue added at a few different points to clarify choices
[*] Additional hints at designated story points
[/list]
[h1]Outstanding Issues:[/h1][list][*] Some players are able to walk over anything on the map
[*] Error popup while saving (although the game should still save) 
[*] Missing save files
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33696968/aeacfeb3a5d85357d8746cdb9b0ae04c12aba862.png[/img]

In addition, I've updated the release schedule for future chapters to reflect these new updates and developments going forward. It's possible I won't be always be able to hit these exact dates, and I appreciate your patience if that ends up being the case. I'm doing my best to release new content regularly, but as a solo developer during a very busy time of year, I can't always pin things down 100%.

Thank you all so much 😊 I hope you're enjoying A Story Beside so far!

 [url=https://twitter.com/wayward_prophet][img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11472989/ddfee936ce044d2b084bd57d8369b1a650c839c5.png[/img][/url] [url=https://youtube.com/c/waywardprophet][img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11472989/1e1136b0f826a0ba78cd7c78fbc4d72f238ac849.png[/img][/url] [img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11472989/132ef7e66b33d581306545db538a3ae2527b3ed6.png[/img]
All my best,
David Grund
